act_title: The Parsi Marriage and Divorce Act, 1936.
title: Superintendence of High Court
text:
51. Superintendence of High Court.—The High Court shall have superintendence over all Courts

constituted under this Act subject to its appellate jurisdiction in the same manner as it has over other
Courts under [article 227 of the Constitution] and all the provisions of [that article] shall apply to such
Courts.
